content.short: Hypekols is a Web3 influencer marketing and analytics platform connecting projects with creators.
content.description: Hypekols is a Web3 influencer marketing platform that connects projects with verified influencers and streamlines campaign management across the full lifecycle. It enables secure escrow payments to support trusted transactions, uses on-chain reviews to bolster transparency, and provides deep analytics to measure impact, reach, and engagement. A unified dashboard brings together all influencer interactions, empowering streamlined outreach, performance monitoring, and collaborative workflows from discovery through post-campaign evaluation.
